children: The predict.fun market for the LPL playoff match between NIP and LGD shows NIP with a 65% chance of winning. According to Odaily, the loser of the best-of-five match at 5 p.m. today will be eliminated from the playoffs, while the winner will face IG in the next round for a spot in the bubble stage.

NIP advanced after a 3-0 sweep of JDG in the first round of the lower bracket yesterday and previously eliminated EDG by the same score in the Knights Road stage. LGD reached the lower bracket after a 3-2 comeback over TES in the first playoff round, then fell 1-3 to AL.

title: NIP Favored Over LGD in LPL Playoff Match on predict.fun
